title: Border Patrol agent hospitalized after reported attack in Laredo; FBI investigating
excerpt: A U.S. Border Patrol agent was taken to Laredo Medical Center on Monday evening after reportedly being attacked while trying to apprehend a person, according to KGNS. The FBI is investigating.
content:
A U.S. Border Patrol agent was taken to Laredo Medical Center on Monday evening, November 9, after reportedly being attacked, according to KGNS.

The agent was trying to apprehend an undocumented immigrant when the suspect reportedly hit the agent over the head with an unknown object, according to KGNS. The agent’s identity has not been released.

The suspect was detained, but the suspect’s immigration status is unknown and no charges have been disclosed, according to KGNS.

The FBI is investigating the incident. Agents wearing FBI vests were seen in the parking lot of Laredo Medical Center, according to KGNS. The FBI and U.S. Customs and Border Protection declined to comment.

KGNS said it would update the story as more information becomes available.

Sources: KGNS, November 10, 2026.
